chapterInfo.content:
16
Efiepanin oniteɛfoɔ no
1Na ɔka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no nso sɛ: Ɔdefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ efiepanin bi, na wɔkɔbɔɔ no kwaadu sɛ ɔsɛe n’adeɛ. 2Na ɔfrɛɛ no see no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mete no wo ho yi? Bɛbu wo paninnie ho nkonta, na worenni panin bio. 3Na efiepanin no kaa ne tirim sɛ: Menyɛ dɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ me wura rebɛgye me paninnie afiri me nsam. Menni ahoɔden a mede mɛtutuo, na ahwa nso yɛ me aniwuo. 4Aane, mahunu deɛ mɛyɛ, na wɔtu me firi me paninnie so a, wɔagye me akɔ wɔn afie. 5Na ɔfrɛɛ ne wura adefirifoɔ nyinaa mmaako mmaako baa ne nkyɛn see deɛ ɔdi kan no sɛ: Wode me wura ɛka ahe? 6Na ɔse: Ngohina ɔha. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Gye wo nwoma, na tena ase ntɛm twerɛ aduonum! 7Ɛnna ɔsee ɔfoforɔ sɛ: Na wo nso, ɛka ahe na wodeɛ? Na ɔse: Mede ayuo nkotokuo ɔha. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Fa wo nwoma na twerɛ aduɔwɔtwe! 8#Efe 5.8; 1 Te 5.5 Na owura no kamfoo efiepanin oniteɛfoɔ no sɛ wadi no nyansam; yei mpo kyerɛ sɛ, wiase yi mma wɔ nyansa sene hann mma wɔn mfɛfoɔ mu.
Ahonyadeɛ kwan pa
9 # Luk 14.14; Mat 6.20; 10.40; 19.21 Na me nso mese mo sɛ, momfa ahonyadeɛ#16.9 Hela no ka sɛ mamon a ɛntene no bi so nya nnamfoɔ, na sɛ ɛhia mo a, wɔagye mo akɔ daa afie no mu. 10#Luk 19.17 Deɛ ɔdi ade ketewa mu nokorɛ no di pii mu nokorɛ; na deɛ ɔntene adeɛ ketewa mu no, na ɔntene bebree mu nso. 11Na enti sɛ moanni ahonyadeɛ a ɛntene no mu nokorɛ a, hwan na ɔde ahodeɛ pa no bɛhyɛ mo nsa? 12Na sɛ moanni obi adeɛ mu nokorɛ a, hwan na ɔde mo deɛ bɛma mo?
Ɔsom afanu
13 # Mat 6.24 Akoa biara ntumi nsom awuranom baanu. Na ɔbɛtane ɔbaako, na wadɔ ɔbaako no, anaasɛ ɔbɛbata ɔbaako ho, na wabu ɔbaako no animtia. Montumi nsom Onyankopɔn ne ahonyadeɛ.
Yesu ka Farisifoɔ anim
14 # Mat 23.14 Na Farisifoɔ no a wɔyɛ sikapɛfoɔ tee yeinom nyinaa; na wɔseree no. 15#Luk 18.9-14; Dwom 7.9; Mmb 6.16-17 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Moyɛ wɔn a wɔbu wɔn ho bem nnipa anim, nanso Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔnim mo akoma mu. Na deɛ ɛyɛ kɛseɛ nnipa mu no yɛ akyiwadeɛ Nyankopɔn anim. 16#Mat 11.12-13 Mmara ne adiyifoɔ no bɛpem Yohane so; na ɛfiri ɛno soɔ no, wɔka Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛmpa, na obiara nam anibereɛ so kɔ mu. 17#Mat 5.18 Na ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam sene sɛ mmara no ho nsensaneeɛ ketewa baako bɛtɔ. 18#Mat 5.32; 19.9 Obiara a ɔgyae ne yere na ɔware ɔfoforɔ no sɛe awadeɛ; na obiara a ɔware deɛ ne kunu agyae no no sɛe awadeɛ.
Ɔdefoɔ ne ohiani no
19 Na ɔdefoɔ bi tenaa ase a na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ pa a ne boɔ yɛ den, na ɔde asetena fɛfɛ gyee n’ani daa. 20Na ohiani bi a watutu akuro nso tenaa ase a wɔfrɛ no Lasaro a wɔde no akɔto n’aboboano. 21Na ne kɔn dɔɔ sɛ ɔdi mporoporowa a ɛfiri ɔdefoɔ no pono soɔ agu fam no meeɛ; nanso akraman ba bɛtaferee n’akuro mu. 22Na ɛbaa sɛ ohiani no wui, na abɔfoɔ bɛsoaa no kɔɔ Abraham kokom. Na ɔdefoɔ no nso wui, na wɔsiee no. 23Na ɔmaa n’ani soɔ wɔ Asamando no, na ɔwɔ aninyanneɛ mu, na ɔhunuu Abraham akyirikyiri ne Lasaro sɛ ɔtwere ne kokom. 24Na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Agya Abraham, hu me mmɔbɔ, na soma Lasaro ma no mfa ne nsateaa ano nkɔbɔ nsuo mu, na ɔmfa mmɛdwodwo me tɛkyerɛma; na merehunu amane ogyaframa yi mu. 25Na Abraham se: Ɔba, kae sɛ wote aseɛ no, wonyaa ahotɔ, na Lasaro nso deɛ, ɔhunuu amane; afei na ne werɛ akyekyerɛ, na wo nso, worehunu amaneɛ. 26Na yei nyinaa nna nkyɛn, eku kɛseɛ da yɛne mo ntam a, wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfiri ha yi ba mo nkyɛn ntumi mma, na wɔn nso a wɔwɔ nohoa ntumi ntra mma yɛn nkyɛn. 27Na ɔse: Ɛnneɛ, agya mesrɛ wo sɛ, soma no ma no nkɔ m’agya fie; 28na mewɔ nuammarimanom baanum, na ɔnkɔdi wɔn adanseɛ, na wɔn nso amma aninyanneɛ mu ha yi bi. 29#2 Ti 3.16 Na Abraham kaa sɛ: Wɔwɔ Mose ne adiyifoɔ no; ma wɔntie wɔn! 30Na ɔse: Dabi, agya Abraham, na sɛ obi firi awufoɔ mu kɔ wɔn nkyɛn a, ɛnna wɔbɛsakyera wɔn adwene. 31Na ɔsee no sɛ: Sɛ wɔantie Mose ne adiyifoɔ no a, obi firi awufoɔ mu sɔre mpo a, wɔrennye no nni.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no nso sɛ: Ɔdefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ efiepanin bi, na wɔkɔbɔɔ no kwaadu sɛ ɔsɛe n’adeɛ. Na ɔfrɛɛ no see no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mete no wo ho yi? Bɛbu wo paninnie ho nkonta, na worenni panin bio. Na efiepanin no kaa ne tirim sɛ: Menyɛ dɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ me wura rebɛgye me paninnie afiri me nsam. Menni ahoɔden a mede mɛtutuo, na ahwa nso yɛ me aniwuo. Aane, mahunu deɛ mɛyɛ, na wɔtu me firi me paninnie so a, wɔagye me akɔ wɔn afie. Na ɔfrɛɛ ne wura adefirifoɔ nyinaa mmaako mmaako baa ne nkyɛn see deɛ ɔdi kan no sɛ: Wode me wura ɛka ahe? Na ɔse: Ngohina ɔha. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Gye wo nwoma, na tena ase ntɛm twerɛ aduonum! Ɛnna ɔsee ɔfoforɔ sɛ: Na wo nso, ɛka ahe na wodeɛ? Na ɔse: Mede ayuo nkotokuo ɔha. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Fa wo nwoma na twerɛ aduɔwɔtwe! Na me nso mese mo sɛ, momfa ahonyadeɛ a ɛntene no bi so nya nnamfoɔ, na sɛ ɛhia mo a, wɔagye mo akɔ daa afie no mu. Deɛ ɔdi ade ketewa mu nokorɛ no di pii mu nokorɛ; na deɛ ɔntene adeɛ ketewa mu no, na ɔntene bebree mu nso. Na enti sɛ moanni ahonyadeɛ a ɛntene no mu nokorɛ a, hwan na ɔde ahodeɛ pa no bɛhyɛ mo nsa? Na sɛ moanni obi adeɛ mu nokorɛ a, hwan na ɔde mo deɛ bɛma mo?

Akoa biara ntumi nsom awuranom baanu. Na ɔbɛtane ɔbaako, na wadɔ ɔbaako no, anaasɛ ɔbɛbata ɔbaako ho, na wabu ɔbaako no animtia. Montumi nsom Onyankopɔn ne ahonyadeɛ.

Na Farisifoɔ no a wɔyɛ sikapɛfoɔ tee yeinom nyinaa; na wɔseree no. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Moyɛ wɔn a wɔbu wɔn ho bem nnipa anim, nanso Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔnim mo akoma mu. Na deɛ ɛyɛ kɛseɛ nnipa mu no yɛ akyiwadeɛ Nyankopɔn anim. Mmara ne adiyifoɔ no bɛpem Yohane so; na ɛfiri ɛno soɔ no, wɔka Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛmpa, na obiara nam anibereɛ so kɔ mu. Na ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam sene sɛ mmara no ho nsensaneeɛ ketewa baako bɛtɔ. Obiara a ɔgyae ne yere na ɔware ɔfoforɔ no sɛe awadeɛ; na obiara a ɔware deɛ ne kunu agyae no no sɛe awadeɛ.

Na ɔdefoɔ bi tenaa ase a na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ pa a ne boɔ yɛ den, na ɔde asetena fɛfɛ gyee n’ani daa. Na ohiani bi a watutu akuro nso tenaa ase a wɔfrɛ no Lasaro a wɔde no akɔto n’aboboano. Na ne kɔn dɔɔ sɛ ɔdi mporoporowa a ɛfiri ɔdefoɔ no pono soɔ agu fam no meeɛ; nanso akraman ba bɛtaferee n’akuro mu. Na ɛbaa sɛ ohiani no wui, na abɔfoɔ bɛsoaa no kɔɔ Abraham kokom. Na ɔdefoɔ no nso wui, na wɔsiee no. Na ɔmaa n’ani soɔ wɔ Asamando no, na ɔwɔ aninyanneɛ mu, na ɔhunuu Abraham akyirikyiri ne Lasaro sɛ ɔtwere ne kokom. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
